provenance.instrument: East Nottingham Township Zoning Ordinance (Chapter 27 Zoning, comprehensive amendment Ord. No. 2005-9 of 12-29-2005, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 EA3684, Township of East Nottingham (27-402.2A: 'East Nottingham Township, Chester County'). District use lists and area and bulk figures are text in Parts 5 to 12. Attachments are the zoning map and map amendments only. The Floodplain Conservation District is in Part 4. New Laws list no Chapter 27 ordinance

No. 2025-01 (Chapter 13), 2025-02 (salaries), 2025-03 (Appendix D), 2025-04 and 2026-01 (Appendix H), 2026-02 (Official Map, Chapter 16) and resolutions, none on Chapter 27
checks: 'Temporary Home for Family Members. A mobile home may be placed upon any lot on a temporary basis for use and occupancy by a family member' (27-1602.1C(7)). It is among the standards for uses permitted by right. The R-1, R-2, R-3 and I-2 use lists allow customary residential accessory uses under 27-1602. No hearing is named

The principal residence 'must have been previously occupied primarily by another family member for a period of not less than two years'. The mobile home is removed within 30 days after the family member dies or leaves, annual status reports go to the Board of Supervisors, and sharing the house's water or sewer needs Chester County Health Department approval (27-1602.1C(7)(a) to (d))

'Area and bulk regulations shall be complied with where physically possible and there shall be permitted only a minimum variance' (27-1602.1C(7)(e)). No principal building or other building with a dwelling unit may stand in a required yard (27-1710.1)

Who may live in the temporary home is not settled. 27-1602.1C(7) says 'a family member'. 27-503.1A(3)(c) calls the same right 'placement of a temporary dwelling on the property for parents or grandparents'. 27-1602.1C(1)(b)3) defines 'immediate family member' 'For purposes of this section' as 'parent, grandparent, child, grandchild, great grandchild, aunt, uncle, niece, or nephew', but C(7) does not use that term

R-1 farm second dwelling: 'a property in agricultural use shall be permitted a second dwelling on the property', attached to the house or detached, with no separate lot. Agricultural use needs at least 10 acres gross. Using it ends the right to a temporary family home on that property (27-503.1A(1), (3))

Residential conversion of a single-family detached dwelling existing when 27-1603 took effect into two or more units is a special exception in R-3, C-1 and C-2. Each unit needs 800 sq ft, the building may not be enlarged except for rear fire escapes and stairs, and the lot needs half the single-family minimum per unit (27-1603.1E)

Two-family dwellings are permitted by right in R-3: 10,000 sq ft per unit with community or public sewage and central water on a tract under five acres as of November 18, 2002 (27-802.1A(4), 27-803.1D). Without those services, 27-803.1E gives one acre to 'any other permitted use not governed by specific standards in Part 16', which is read to reach a two-family dwelling

Floodplain Conservation District: only uses without structures are permitted by right. Additions to existing structures are a conditional use, elevated 1 1/2 ft above the 100-year flood. Mobile and manufactured homes are prohibited, and no special exception or variance may be granted for them (27-402.3, 4F, 5A, 8B(6)). No on-site sewage system may be built there (27-402.4E, 7G(2))

Slopes over 25% allow only parks, selective tree cutting, a minimum driveway and their accessory uses (27-405.1). In the Riparian Corridor Conservation District the Chester County Conservation District's regulations apply (27-403)

Residential accessory buildings stand at least 10 ft from side and rear lines and not in a front yard (27-503.1D, 27-703.1E, 27-803.1F). Detached residential accessory structures may be 15 ft tall on a lot under one acre, 25 ft on one to five acres and 35 ft on five acres or more (27-1602.1B(1))
C-1, C-2 and I-1 permit no single-family dwelling. 'Residential uses are not permitted' in I-1 (27-1101.2), where any other lawful use not listed is a conditional use (27-1102.1C(3))
No use variance bar was found. The Zoning Hearing Board decides variances on the findings of 27-2204.2

In the Floodplain Conservation District no structure is permitted by right, so a house there is a nonconforming structure. In the floodway it 'shall not be expanded or enlarged'. Any modification, alteration or improvement of a nonconforming structure in the floodway, and any expansion or alteration of one in the flood fringe, needs a special exception from the Zoning Hearing Board (27-402.6A, B)

A mobile home may also serve as a temporary dwelling while a house damaged by fire or disaster is repaired, under a temporary use permit that expires after eight months. That is not a second unit (27-1602.1C(8)(b))
On a property in agricultural use, no dwelling may stand closer than 50 ft to a front property line or 25 ft to a side or rear property line or right-of-way line (27-503.1A(5))
In R-2 and R-3 a single-family detached dwelling on a tract of five acres or more as of November 18, 2002, not using the retained open space option, is a conditional use (27-702.1C(4), 27-802.1C(2))
R-1A is an overlay on R-1 properties named on the zoning map. Its uses and figures are those of R-1, with its own cluster density (27-603.1A, 27-604.1A)
C-1 and C-2 permit one dwelling unit in a building that houses a commercial use (27-902.1A(14), 27-1002.1A(22)). That is not a unit added to a house lot

value.name: Second dwelling on a property in agricultural use (R-1, R-1A)
value.conditions: 'In addition to a principal single-family detached dwelling, a property in agricultural use shall be permitted a second dwelling on the property.' It may be attached to the house or detached. A detached one meets the R-1 dwelling yards, and no dwelling on a property in agricultural use stands closer than 50 ft to a front line or 25 ft to a side or rear line. No separate lot may be created for it. Agricultural use needs at least 10 acres gross. The owner submits a Chester County Health Department permit for an individual on-lot sewage system that serves the house and the 'accessory dwelling unit', so the unit is read as one on on-lot sewage (27-503.1A(1), (3)(a), (d), (5))

requires.condition: The property is in agricultural use

value.note: Using it ends the right to a temporary family home on the property (27-503.1A(3)(c)). No family rule. In the Floodplain Conservation District no new structure is permitted by right, and an addition to the house needs a conditional use and a special exception (27-402.3, 27-402.6B)

value.name: Residential conversion (R-3)
value.conditions: A single-family detached dwelling 'existing on the effective date of this section' may become a two-family or multi-family dwelling. Each unit has at least 800 sq ft. The lot needs 50% of the single-family minimum for its sewage type times the number of units, so two units need one single-family lot. The building may not be enlarged except for fire escapes and outside stairways at the rear. At most five units (27-1603.1E(3)). For two units in R-3: 15,000 sq ft with community or public sewage and central water, one acre otherwise (27-803.1C, E)

requires.condition: The house existed when 27-1603 took effect (Ord. No. 2005-9, 12-29-2005)

value.note: A unit inside the existing house, not tied to relatives. The lot figures are for two units

value.name: Residential conversion (C-1, C-2)
value.conditions: A single-family detached dwelling 'existing on the effective date of this section' may become a two-family or multi-family dwelling. Each unit has at least 800 sq ft. The lot needs 50% of the single-family minimum for its sewage type times the number of units, so two units need one single-family lot. The building may not be enlarged except for fire escapes and outside stairways at the rear. At most five units (27-1603.1E(3)). For two units in C-1 and C-2: one-half acre with public water and sewer, one acre with on-site water and sewer (27-903.1A(1), 27-1003.1A(1))

requires.condition: The house existed when 27-1603 took effect (Ord. No. 2005-9, 12-29-2005)

Otherwise one acre, front 50 ft, side 25 ft, rear 50 ft, impervious surface 20%, read under 27-803.1E for 'any other permitted use'. One space per half dwelling unit (27-803.1D, E, 27-1902.2E)
value.note: A building with two units. Whether an existing house may become one outside the residential conversion rules (27-1603.1E) is not settled. Whether 27-803.1E reaches a two-family dwelling without public services is a reading

districts_read_no_listing.note: 'Residential uses are not permitted in this district'

districts_in_doubt.note: C-1 and C-2 permit no single-family dwelling but list 'Other uses customarily accessory to commercial or residential uses' under 27-1602, and 27-1602.1C(7) says 'any lot'. A house there is a nonconforming use

value.condition: Only a family member may live in the mobile home. Who counts is not settled. 27-1602.1C(7) says 'a family member'. 27-503.1A(3)(c) calls it 'a temporary dwelling on the property for parents or grandparents'. 27-1602.1C(1)(b)3) defines 'immediate family member' for 27-1602 as a parent, grandparent, child, grandchild, great grandchild, aunt, uncle, niece or nephew, though C(7) does not use that term.

'the principal residence must have been previously occupied primarily by another family member for a period of not less than two years'. The mobile home is 'a secondary or supplemental residence for the occupant'.
Annual status reports go to the Board of Supervisors, and the mobile home is removed within 30 days after the death or departure of the family member.
Use of the house's water or sewer system needs Chester County Health Department approval.

'Area and bulk regulations shall be complied with where physically possible and there shall be permitted only a minimum variance from the terms and conditions thereof.' The mobile home may have no adverse aesthetic effect and may not add traffic or fire hazard.

On a property in agricultural use, creating the farm second dwelling under 27-503.1A(3) 'shall eliminate the opportunity otherwise provided in § 27-1602 for placement of a temporary dwelling on the property for parents or grandparents'.

In the Floodplain Conservation District 'The construction, placement, enlargement, or expansion of mobile homes' and manufactured homes is prohibited, and no special exception or variance may be granted for it.

No structure is permitted by right in the Floodplain Conservation District, so a house there is a nonconforming structure. In the floodway it 'shall not be expanded or enlarged'. Any alteration or improvement of it in the floodway, and any expansion, enlargement or alteration of it in the flood fringe, 'must be authorized as a special exception by the Zoning Hearing Board'. An addition also needs a conditional use and must be elevated 1 1/2 ft above the 100-year flood.
Where the slope exceeds 25% the only uses permitted are parks and outdoor recreation, selective tree cutting, the minimum driveway to a house and their accessory uses.
In the Riparian Corridor Conservation District 'The regulations established for the Chester County Conservation District shall apply'.
